root_facts: Approved staff-service and client-contract template artifacts with content and mapping digests.
Matching-plan segments, immutable generated document bytes, returned signed-document bytes and typed send/sign commands.
Exact deposit bank receipt, customer-signature command and execution-conversion command with fixed clock and idempotency identities.
forbidden_direct_seed: contract signing status, contract identity, order status, execution assignment or effective schedule
client-receivable summaries, payroll, subsidy, calendar, alert, outbox or command receipt projections
document overwrite, deletion, mutable template mapping or arbitrary local file as generated contract
commands: Generate each staff contract from an approved template, send it, archive signed return and record the staff signature.
Create the exact pre-contract service commitment only after all staff signatures, then generate, send and record the client contract return.
Reconcile the exact deposit before client signing, then test customer signing, replay, stale document and execution-conversion guards.
expected: Each generated or returned document is immutable, digest-linked and auditable; invalid/expired inputs leave no partial signing event.
Deposit settlement can produce Orders=訂單成立 while Contract=等待客戶簽回 and no execution schedule exists.
Only the combined commitment, client-signature and settled-deposit roots allow execution conversion; API and UI expose every normal, blocker and repair state.
Preview and query perform zero business writes; exact replay returns one receipt and changed idempotency payload conflicts.
Archive failure, stale document version and staff/client order violations leave document, event, finance and schedule projections unchanged.
receipt_requirements: typed API/UI blocker and repair snapshots
